items.quote: I’m receiving at least 5 calls a day from different agents in Dubai, but I do not want to deal with them…
items.statement: I’m receiving at least 5 calls a day from different agents in Dubai, but I do not want to deal with them…

items.quote: most of the time this means that after the agent did the ‘convincing part’ and sent several options, the client stopped responding.
items.statement: Clients often stop responding after agents send several options, which is a common experience.

items.quote: No wonder clients are indecisive - they hear different agents trying to convince them about various investments and often, they are given contradictory information.
items.statement: Clients are indecisive due to contradictory information from different agents.

items.quote: Do not assume. Be curious about this particular client’s situation.
items.statement: Do not assume and be curious about the client’s situation during the sales process.

items.quote: - Clarify the intentions. “Let’s say, we found a property which matches your criteria XYZ, what would be your next possible steps?”
items.statement: Clarify the client's intentions to guide the sales process effectively.

overview: LinkedIn post about client engagement in real estate sales.
